note: Runner self-checks for host-independent setups. $LSTART1 is filled in the zone of the helper call that reads it: a step's own tz, a TZ in a step's env, else the case's; a lock owned by pid 1 with that start time is a live owner (pin: REFUSED pin-locked), where a start time read in another zone would read as stale and be taken over. The zones are POSIX TZ strings, so no tz database is needed. A case whose vars take $LSTART1 and whose step runs in another zone stops with a runner error. bin_mirror links every entry of a folder but the excepted names (a PATH without git on hosts where /bin is /usr/bin)
